## About makOS (the site itself)

makOS is a portfolio built as a desktop operating system in React 19 and TypeScript, with Zustand for
state, tested with Vitest and Playwright (with axe accessibility checks in CI), and hosted on Vercel.
Source: https://github.com/makenna615/makOS

- Hand-built window manager: drag, resize, minimize, maximize, and snap windows to half the screen. No window library.
- Three themes (Retro, Modern, Future), each with its own animated wallpaper drawn with WebGL or canvas.
- Apps: About Me, Resume, Projects (Fourth Down, Memories into Perfumes), Contact, a Terminal that answers
  questions about Makenna from her resume data, and a Games folder with Bug Sweeper (a developer-themed
  mine-sweeping puzzle) and Stackdle (a daily 5-letter tech-word game with clues from her resume).
- Search with Ctrl+K, movable desktop icons, keyboard access throughout, and a phone layout.
- Parts most visitors don't open (games, terminal, project windows) load on demand to keep the first load small.
